```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r population}
invroot <- function(covmat) {
  eig <- eigen(covmat, symmetric = TRUE)
  eig$vectors %*% diag(1 / sqrt(eig$values), nrow = length(eig$values)) %*% t(eig$vectors)
}

truecca <- function(cov1, cov2, cov12) {
  root1 <- invroot(cov1)
  eig <- eigen(root1 %*% cov12 %*% solve(cov2) %*% t(cov12) %*% root1, symmetric = TRUE)
  list(cor = sqrt(eig$values[1]), weights = root1 %*% eig$vectors[, 1])
}
```

```{r params}
set.seed(67)
pergroup  <- 25
highnum   <- 5
highvar   <- 10
linkednum <- 3
linkcor   <- 0.2
trainsize <- c(60, 100, 200, 500, 1000)
pckept    <- c(1, 3, 5, 10, 15)
reps      <- 200
testsize  <- 5000
set1cols  <- 1:pergroup
set2cols  <- (pergroup + 1):(2 * pergroup)

scenarios <- c("3 High-Variance"                 = 3,
               "2 High-Variance, 1 Low-Variance" = 2,
               "1 High-Variance, 2 Low-Variance" = 1,
               "3 Low-Variance"                  = 0)
```

```{r generation}
makepop <- function(highlinked) {
  linkedvars <- c(seq_len(highlinked), highnum + seq_len(linkednum - highlinked))

  corwithin <- diag(pergroup)
  corwithin[linkedvars, linkedvars] <- linkcor
  diag(corwithin) <- 1
  corbetween <- matrix(0, pergroup, pergroup)
  corbetween[linkedvars, linkedvars] <- linkcor
  cormat <- rbind(cbind(corwithin, corbetween), cbind(t(corbetween), corwithin))

  variances <- c(rep(highvar, highnum), rep(1, pergroup - highnum))
  sds       <- diag(sqrt(c(variances, variances)))
  covmat    <- sds %*% cormat %*% sds

  cov1  <- covmat[set1cols, set1cols]
  cov2  <- covmat[set2cols, set2cols]
  cov12 <- covmat[set1cols, set2cols]
  truth <- truecca(cov1, cov2, cov12)
  list(covmat = covmat, cov1 = cov1, cov2 = cov2, cov12 = cov12,
       cor = truth$cor, weights = truth$weights)
}

drawdata <- function(n, pop) {
  alldata <- MASS::mvrnorm(n, mu = rep(0, 2 * pergroup), Sigma = pop$covmat)
  list(set1 = alldata[, set1cols], set2 = alldata[, set2cols])
}
```

```{r eda, fig.width=8, fig.height=3, out.width="100%"}
pop <- makepop(1)
dat <- drawdata(200, pop)
alldata <- cbind(dat$set1, dat$set2)
linked <- c(1, 6, 7)

par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1))

shown   <- c(1:10, 26:35)
labels  <- c(paste0(1:10, "(1)"), paste0(1:10, "(2)"))
colours <- hcl.colors(21, "Blue-Red 3")

cormat <- cov2cor(pop$covmat)[shown, shown]
image(1:20, 1:20, cormat[, 20:1],
      col = colours, zlim = c(-0.4, 0.4), axes = FALSE,
      main = "True correlations", xlab = "", ylab = "")
axis(1, 1:20, labels, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.6)
axis(2, 20:1, labels, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.6)
abline(v = 10.5, h = 10.5, lwd = 2)

cormat <- cor(alldata)[shown, shown]
diag(cormat) <- NA
image(1:20, 1:20, cormat[, 20:1],
      col = colours, zlim = c(-0.4, 0.4), axes = FALSE,
      main = "Sample correlations (n = 200)", xlab = "", ylab = "")
axis(1, 1:20, labels, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.6)
axis(2, 20:1, labels, las = 1, cex.axis = 0.6)
abline(v = 10.5, h = 10.5, lwd = 2)

barplot(apply(alldata, 2, var), col = ifelse(rep(1:25, 2) %in% linked, "red", "gray"),
        border = NA, space = 0,
        main = "Sample variances", xlab = "Variable", ylab = "Variance")
abline(v = 25, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", c("Linked", "Not linked"), fill = c("red", "gray"), bty = "n")
```

```{r methods}
fitcca <- function(dat) {
  fit <- cancor(dat$set1, dat$set2)
  list(cor = fit$cor[1], w1 = fit$xcoef[, 1], w2 = fit$ycoef[, 1])
}

fitpcacca <- function(dat, npc) {
  dirs1 <- eigen(cov(dat$set1), symmetric = TRUE)$vectors[, 1:npc, drop = FALSE]
  dirs2 <- eigen(cov(dat$set2), symmetric = TRUE)$vectors[, 1:npc, drop = FALSE]
  fit   <- cancor(dat$set1 %*% dirs1, dat$set2 %*% dirs2)
  list(cor = fit$cor[1], w1 = dirs1 %*% fit$xcoef[, 1], w2 = dirs2 %*% fit$ycoef[, 1])
}
```

```{r scoring}
score <- function(fit, pop, test) {
  fitted1 <- test$set1 %*% fit$w1
  fitted2 <- test$set2 %*% fit$w2
  true1   <- test$set1 %*% pop$weights
  c(training  = fit$cor,
    test      = abs(cor(fitted1, fitted2)),
    recovery  = abs(cor(fitted1, true1)))
}
```

```{r simulation}
methods <- c("CCA", paste0("PCA(", pckept, ")+CCA"))
pops    <- lapply(scenarios, makepop)
tests   <- lapply(pops, function(pop) drawdata(testsize, pop))
round(sapply(pops, `[[`, "cor"), 3)

design <- expand.grid(scenario = names(pops), n = trainsize, rep = 1:reps,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(design)), function(i) {
  cell   <- design[i, ]
  pop    <- pops[[cell$scenario]]
  dat    <- drawdata(cell$n, pop)
  fits   <- c(list(fitcca(dat)), lapply(pckept, function(npc) fitpcacca(dat, npc)))
  scores <- t(sapply(fits, score, pop = pop, test = tests[[cell$scenario]]))
  data.frame(scenario = cell$scenario, n = cell$n, rep = cell$rep,
             method = methods, scores, row.names = NULL)
}))
results$method <- factor(results$method, levels = methods)

means <- aggregate(cbind(training, test, recovery) ~ scenario + n + method,
                   data = results, FUN = mean)
means$scenario <- factor(means$scenario, levels = names(scenarios))
means <- means[order(means$scenario, means$n, means$method), ]
means$truecor <- sapply(as.character(means$scenario), function(s) pops[[s]]$cor)

numeric <- vapply(means, is.numeric, logical(1))
means[numeric] <- lapply(means[numeric], round, digits = 3)
print(means, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(results, "sim-raw.csv",     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(means,   "sim-summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r tables}
library(kableExtra)
shown <- c(60, 200, 1000)
summ  <- aggregate(cbind(training, test, recovery) ~ method + n,
                   data = results[results$n %in% shown, ], FUN = mean)
wide  <- reshape(summ, idvar = "method", timevar = "n", direction = "wide")

header <- c(" " = 1, setNames(rep(3, length(shown)), paste("n =", shown)))
cols   <- c("Method", rep(c("Training", "Test", "Recovery"), length(shown)))

truecor <- pops[[1]]$cor  

bold_best <- function(k, df, digits = 3) {
  for (j in 2:ncol(df)) {
    x <- round(df[[j]], digits)
    if (startsWith(names(df)[j], "training")) {
      d <- abs(x - truecor)                      
      k <- column_spec(k, j, bold = !is.na(d) & d == min(d, na.rm = TRUE))
    } else {
      k <- column_spec(k, j, bold = !is.na(x) & x == max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    }
  }
  k
}

tab <- kbl(wide, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE,
           col.names = cols) |>
  bold_best(wide) |>
  add_header_above(header) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"))
writeLines(as.character(tab), "sim-table.tex")

kbl(wide, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE, col.names = cols) |>
  bold_best(wide) |>
  add_header_above(header) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r plot, fig.width=14, fig.height=12, out.width="100%"}
metrics <- c(training  = "Training Set Correlation",
             test      = "Test Set Correlation",
             recovery  = "Recovery of True U1")
colours  <- c("black", hcl.colors(length(pckept), "Dark 3"))
nmetrics <- length(metrics)
nscen    <- length(pops)

layout(cbind(matrix(seq_len(nscen * nmetrics), nrow = nscen, byrow = TRUE),
             nscen * nmetrics + 1),
       widths = c(rep(1, nmetrics), 0.8))
par(mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2.5, 1), cex.main = 0.9)

for (scen in names(pops)) {
  rows <- means[means$scenario == scen, ]
  for (metric in names(metrics)) {
    plot(NA, xlim = range(log10(trainsize)), ylim = c(0, 1), xaxt = "n",
         xlab = "Training Set Size", ylab = metrics[metric],
         main = sprintf("%s: %s", scen, metrics[metric]))
    axis(1, at = log10(trainsize), labels = trainsize)
    abline(h = if (metric == "recovery") 1 else pops[[scen]]$cor, lty = 2, col = "gray")
    for (j in seq_along(methods)) {
      line   <- rows[rows$method == methods[j], ]
      offset <- (j - (length(methods) + 1) / 2) * 0.012
      lines(log10(line$n) + offset, line[[metric]], col = colours[j], lwd = 2,
            type = "b", pch = 19)
    }
  }
}

par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0)); plot.new()
legend("center", legend = c(methods, "truth"), col = c(colours, "gray"),
       lwd = 2, lty = c(rep(1, length(methods)), 2), bty = "n", cex = 0.9)
```
